components.css: .ds-panel{position:relative;margin:7px;padding:48px;border-radius:10px;color:#fff;background:#c8161d linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,0) 34%,rgba(0,0,0,.06));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #949fa9,0 0 0 6px #d3d9de,0 0 0 7px #9aa5ae}.ds-panel h2{margin:0;font:700 44px/1 'Sofia Sans Condensed',Arial Narrow,sans-serif;color:#fff}.ds-panel::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:14px;left:16px;right:16px;height:9px;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,#fff0bd 0 22%,#ffb81f 48%,#e89300 86%,rgba(232,147,0,0)) left/18px 9px no-repeat,radial-gradient(closest-side,#fff0bd 0 22%,#ffb81f 48%,#e89300 86%,rgba(232,147,0,0)) right/18px 9px no-repeat}

components.css: .ds-locker{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:320px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.32),0 0 0 4px #d6dce1,0 0 0 5px #8e99a3;font:420 16px/1.5 'Sofia Sans',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-win{aspect-ratio:16/10;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d0021b,#a51219)}.ds-glass{margin-top:-56px;padding:18px 22px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.35)}.ds-glass h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:700 26px/1.06 'Sofia Sans Condensed',Arial Narrow,sans-serif;color:#1d2227}.ds-glass p{margin:0 0 6px;color:#2e363d}.ds-glass a{color:#1d2227;font-weight:650;text-underline-offset:5px;margin-right:18px}.ds-glass a.ds-offer{color:#a51219}

narrative.overview: Every section is one object of the product's world – red body, glazed compartment, clear hatch, riveted plate – on a daylight steel ground. Transparency is the compartments' frosted glass, through which the product's renders stay visible.
keyCharacteristics: Signal-red bodies in a galvanised frame with rivets and amber marker lights
Frosted compartments over the client's renders
Riveted aluminium plates for figures and forms
Sofia Sans Condensed as vehicle lettering

rules.name: One red mass per viewport
rules.body: Red is the body, never scattered accents.

rules.name: Glass is white
rules.body: Frosted panels are white at 80% with a 14px blur, so text stays legible over any render.

dos: Build sections from body, compartment, plate or hatch
Pair every Learn more with Get an offer
donts: No neon glows, gradient text or eyebrow labels
